extends: scripts/w2r1/prereg.json (unchanged, sha256 6caf1f70ad2a926b368927c521d799311f09191963bf17c957c6959701cb521d): breakout labels, models M0/M1/M2 and gates B1-B6 are the preregistered ones; this file only FIXES the remaining design constants. No threshold, label or split is loosened.
declared_before: any S6 model fit, any S6 validation scoring, any look at 2026 outcomes. S4 (K/DST expected points) and S5 (tactical layers) are closed and are not re-opened here.
objective: Decide, per position, whether point-in-time pregame evidence identifies MATERIALLY ELEVATED upside probability relative to a tier-conditional base rate. NO RELIABLE BREAKOUT SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE are acceptable and preferred over an overfit probability. No hand-weighted hype score exists.

splits.VAL: 2025 weeks 3-17 (VAL-contaminated weeks 14-17 are used for validation only)
splits.FINAL: 2026 weeks 1-5: NOT loaded, NOT scored; S7 only after FROZEN.json
splits.time_split_only: random train/test splits are forbidden; model selection uses time order only; VAL-LATE = constants chosen on VAL weeks 3-9 and scored on weeks 10-17

population.rule: point-in-time pregame population: a player whose most recent PLAYED game was for the target team within that team's previous 3 games, with as-of B0p(HALF) >= 3 (prereg relevance floor) and a headline designation NONE / QUESTIONABLE / DOUBTFUL (OUT is excluded from the label population: it is Wave-1 availability, not breakout). The target game's played flag is an OUTCOME: a player who does not play stays in the population with label 0 (this removes the survivor bias of conditioning on playing).
population.availability: W1 owns availability: S6 neither models injury nor re-discounts; designation states are carried as covariates (NONE/Q/D) only; bye weeks are not targets (no game); unknown designation = NONE with the reconstruction flag (RECONSTRUCTED_FINAL_DESIGNATION, symmetric across candidates).
population.no_pooling: every position (and every label) is fitted, calibrated and judged separately; K/DST use SPIKE internally

labels.rank_population: all players at the position with a stat line that week (the rank is among everyone who played, not only the study population)
labels.tie_rule: label = actual HALF points >= the value of the N-th ranked player that week (ties included)

SECONDARY_reported_only.residual: actual - B0p >= 1.5 x SD(actual - B0p) estimated on FIT played rows of the position

labels.rule: only PRIMARY drives model choice and verdicts; SECONDARY labels may not be substituted after results are seen. Base rates are reported for every label.

base_rates.M0: tier-conditional empirical base rate: tier by as-of B0p(HALF): STARTER >= 12, FLEX 6 to < 12, FRINGE 3 to < 6; rate estimated on FIT per position and tier (Laplace-smoothed: (events+1)/(n+2))
base_rates.position_base_rate: FIT rate over the whole position population (reported beside every comparable-situation statement)

feature_families.TIER: B0p tier (cohort baseline; always in every candidate through M0)
feature_families.TREND_definition: mean of the last 3 PLAYED games minus mean of the 3 before them (needs >= 6 played games; otherwise UNKNOWN, never 0)
feature_families.S5_DIAG: S5 opponent-response / tendency ratios (MULTI mode) used ONLY as diagnostic covariates in the last candidate; S5 found no validated signal in them and S6 does not treat them as validated
unavailable_documented: route participation trend (participation data absent 2026; Tier B)

candidate_ladder.M1: L2-regularised logistic regression on standardized features, intercept unpenalized; penalty lambda = 1/C, C in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10] chosen on VAL log loss (ties -> smaller C); rows with unknown features get the neutral M0 probability FLAGGED (never zero)
candidate_ladder.M2: calibrated gradient-boosted trees ONLY if M1 beats M0 on VAL AND the position has >= 300 positive events in FIT+VAL; otherwise NOT fitted. Preference: M0 over M1 over M2 unless the gate below is met.
candidate_ladder.inclusion_rule: a step is retained if its VAL log loss improves on the previous retained step by >= 0.002 AND its Brier 95% team-week bootstrap lower bound vs that step is > 0 (B=2000, seed 20261014); the verdict is judged on the last retained candidate vs M0.

calibration.method: NO post-hoc recalibration: M1 probabilities are used as fitted (a recalibrated score would be a second model); calibration is MEASURED: reliability slope (logit regression of the label on logit p), ECE with 10 equal-mass bins (bins with < 10 rows merged), tail stability, tiny-top-decile warnings
calibration.display: probabilities are shown only for a position whose gates pass; otherwise `NO RELIABLE BREAKOUT SIGNAL`; probabilities are banded (Low / Typical / Elevated / High) and rounded to whole percent; a raw classifier score is never shown as a probability

alerts.note: thresholds fixed here; precision / recall / lift reported at both; altering them after validation is forbidden

missing_data.small_sample_weight: p_shown = w * p_model + (1 - w) * tier_base_rate with w = 1 (>= 4 prior played games), 0.6 (2-3), 0 (< 2): missing history lowers confidence toward the BASE RATE, never to 0 and never to a confident extreme
missing_data.rookies_and_role_changes: evaluated as explicit subgroups (years_exp 0, < 4 prior games, recent team change, injury return, large trend shifts) with their own base rate and calibration

metrics: Brier skill vs M0 (relative, with bootstrap CI)
precision / recall at ELEVATED and HIGH

gates.B1: VAL positive events >= 40 else INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE (the same >= 40 applies to FINAL at S7)
gates.B2: Brier skill vs M0 >= 2% relative with bootstrap lower bound > 0
gates.B5: top-decile lift >= 1.3 with >= 10 events in the top decile
gates.B6: negative examples reported for every feature family (n positive / n negative / empirical rate / lift)

verdict_labels.VALIDATION CANDIDATE: B1-B5 pass on VAL AND on VAL-LATE
verdict_labels.DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: B2 passes but B4 or B5 fails (probabilities not displayable)

negative_examples: for every feature family the study reports, in the VAL population: rows where the 'breakout-looking' condition (top-quintile of the family's standardized composite score computed on FIT constants, per position) held; n positive, n negative, empirical rate, lift over the position base rate. The composite is a DESCRIPTIVE cohort selector, never a model output.
K_DST_spike: K and D/ST spike probability is evaluated with the S4 simulated component distribution (M_sim), the tercile base rate (M0) and a logistic M1 on [model expected points, model SD]; fitted on FIT, C chosen on VAL log loss. K/DST expected-points qualification (S4) and spike qualification are SEPARATE verdicts.

leakage_controls.poison: recompute features for sampled VAL targets after replacing the target game and every later game of the player and team with absurd values: byte-identical
leakage_controls.label_isolation: labels are computed from outcomes only after features; no feature column may be a function of the target-game outcome (poison + column audit)
leakage_controls.later_weeks_and_season_end: covered by the poison test (all later rows replaced); no season aggregate columns exist
leakage_controls.postgame_depth_and_injury: depth-chart data is not used at all; injury designation is the reconstructed final team-week designation used identically by M0 and M1; no postgame-only field is read
leakage_controls.oracle: target-game actual usage (targets/carries/dropbacks) as features must beat M0 by a wide margin (>= 25% Brier improvement) proving the harness would expose leakage
leakage_controls.time_split: a test asserts every FIT target precedes every VAL target in (season, week) order

stop_point: validation only; FROZEN.json not created; 2026 weeks 1-5 not loaded; prereg.json untouched.
